people.name: Inoue Enryō
people.field: philosopher, Shin Buddhist priest and reformer, educator

relations.subject: Inoue Enryō
relations.evidence: Before entering Tokyo University in 1881... On the occasion of his graduation in 1885

relations.subject: Inoue Enryō
relations.evidence: In 1887, he set up a Philosophy Publishing House 哲学書院, edited the first issue of the Journal of the Philosophy Society『哲学会雑誌』and founded the Philosophy Academy 哲学館, the predecessor of today's Toyo University

relations.subject: Inoue Enryō
relations.evidence: In his lectures at the Philosophy Academy, Inoue pioneered several academic fields... Inoue's resignation from the Academy in 1905/06

relations.subject: Inoue Enryō
relations.evidence: In 1896, Inoue was the first to be awarded a Doctor of Letters by submitting a thesis to the Faculty of Literature of Tokyo Imperial University.
